chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām, who said:

I was present at al-Bayt al-Haram when a man was calling out to Abū Jaʿfar al-Dawānīqī while he was performing tawaf, saying: “O Commander of the Faithful, these two men came to my brother at night and took him out of his house, and he did not return to me. By Allah, I do not know what they did with him.” So he said to them: “What did you do with him?”

They said: “O Commander of the Faithful, we only spoke with him, then he returned to his house.” He said to them: “Come to me tomorrow at the time of salat al-ʿAsr in this place.” They came to him the next day at salat al-ʿAsr, and he said to Abū ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, while holding his hand: “O Jaʿfar, judge between them.” He said: “You judge between them.” He said to him: “By my right over you, you must judge between them.” He said: Then Jaʿfar عليه السلام came out, and a reed prayer-mat was spread for him, and he sat on it. Then the disputants came and sat before him, and he said to the claimant: “What do you say?”

He said: “O son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, these two came to my brother at night and took him out of his house. By Allah, he did not return to me, and by Allah, I do not know what they did with him.” He said: “What do you two say?”

They said: “O son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, we spoke with him, then he returned to his house.” Abū ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام said: “O servant, write: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.”

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Whoever comes to a man at night and brings him out of his house is liable for him, unless he establishes clear proof that he returned him to his house.” O servant, remove this one of the two and strike his neck.

He said: “O son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, I did not kill him, but I only restrained him, then this one came and stabbed him and killed him.” He said: “I am the son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. O servant, remove this one, and strike his neck for the other.”

He said: “O son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, by Allah, I did not torture him, but I killed him with a single blow.” So he ordered concerning his brother, and his neck was struck. Then he ordered regarding the other, and his sides were beaten, and he was imprisoned. And he wrote at the head of his record: He is to be imprisoned for his lifetime and struck fifty lashes every year.

key_terms.الْبَيْتِ الْحَرَامِ: the Sacred House, the sanctuary of the Kaʿbah in Makkah
key_terms.الْخُصَمَاءُ: the disputing parties in a legal case

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone takes a man out of his house at night and he does not return?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a judicial ruling of Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning two men accused of taking a man out at night, after which he disappeared and was killed. It establishes liability for one who removes a person from his home by night unless proof is produced of his safe return, and it distinguishes between the direct killer and the accomplice in punishment.
